name: io.github.Credda-io/credda
title: Credda
description: Read what Credda found in your repositories: investigations, evidence, resolutions, findings.

environmentVariables.name: CREDDA_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Credda API (apps/api). Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:4317, the loopback address a local install publishes.

environmentVariables.name: CREDDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer key for the Credda API. Required when that API runs with CREDDA_AUTH=enforced; omit it for a local install with auth disabled. The key grants reads across its organisation.
